name: Animals (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 32 questions on animals, written by Claude. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-03, from its own knowledge: no API call and no source document. NOT checked against a source.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.

items.question: What do we call a baby dog?
items.explain: A young dog is a puppy.

items.question: What do we call a baby cat?
items.explain: A young cat is a kitten.

items.question: What do we call a baby sheep?
items.explain: A young sheep is a lamb; a kid is a baby goat.

items.question: What do we call a baby horse?
items.explain: A newborn horse is a foal.

items.question: Which animal is called the king of the jungle?
items.explain: The lion has long been called the king of the jungle, though it really lives on grassland.

items.question: What is the tallest animal in the world?
items.explain: With its long neck, a giraffe can stand taller than a house door twice over.

items.question: What is the largest animal alive today?
items.explain: The blue whale is bigger than any other animal living now.

items.question: How many legs does an insect have?
items.explain: Every insect has six legs; spiders, with eight, are not insects.

items.question: Which farm animal says moo?
items.explain: Cows moo; pigs oink, sheep baa and horses neigh.

items.question: Which bird is a national symbol of the United States?
items.explain: The bald eagle has been the national emblem since 1782.

items.question: Which animal has a long trunk?
items.explain: An elephant uses its trunk to smell, drink and pick things up.

items.question: What do giant pandas mostly eat?
items.explain: Almost everything a wild giant panda eats is bamboo.

items.question: Which animal is the fastest runner on land?
items.explain: A cheetah can sprint faster than any other land animal.

items.question: Which animal carries its baby in a pouch?
items.explain: A baby kangaroo, called a joey, grows in its mother's pouch.

items.question: What is a group of wolves called?
items.explain: Wolves live and hunt together in a pack.

items.question: What is a group of fish called?
items.explain: Fish swimming together are called a school.

items.question: What is a group of lions called?
items.explain: Lions live in family groups called prides.

items.question: Which is the only mammal that can truly fly?
items.explain: Bats flap their wings to fly; a flying squirrel only glides.

items.question: What is the largest bird in the world?
items.explain: The ostrich is the biggest bird; it is too heavy to fly.

items.question: What does a caterpillar grow up to become?
items.explain: A caterpillar wraps itself up and comes out as a butterfly.

items.question: How many arms does an octopus have?
items.explain: Octo means eight: an octopus has eight arms.

items.question: Which animal is famous for building dams in rivers?
items.explain: Beavers build dams out of sticks and mud.

items.question: What do we call a grown male chicken?
items.explain: A male chicken is a rooster; a female is a hen.

items.question: On which continent do emperor penguins live?
items.explain: Emperor penguins live only in and around icy Antarctica.

items.question: What do we call a baby frog?
items.explain: A frog starts life in the water as a tadpole.

items.question: What do we call a baby deer?
items.explain: A young deer, often with white spots, is a fawn.

items.question: Which animal has black and white stripes?
items.explain: Zebras have stripes; leopards and cheetahs have spots.

items.question: What does a camel store in its hump?
items.explain: A camel's hump is fat, which it can live on when food is scarce.

items.question: Which is the largest kind of wild cat?
items.explain: The tiger is the biggest of the wild cats.

items.question: What do we call an animal that eats only plants?
items.explain: Herbivores eat plants; carnivores eat meat; omnivores eat both.

items.question: Which farm animal gives us wool?
items.explain: Wool is the thick coat sheared from sheep.

items.question: Which slow-moving animal spends most of its life hanging upside down in trees?
items.explain: Sloths hang from branches and move very slowly.
